news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.97 loss per share (vs ₹0.03 profit in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.97 loss per share (down from ₹0.03 profit in 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹9.73m (down ₹10.4m from profit in 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, the company's share price growth rate has exceeded its earnings growth rate by 102 percentage points per year, which is a significant difference in performance.

news.title: Sparc Electrex Limited Announces Resignation of Ashish Mishra as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective January 24, 2026
news.body: Sparc Electrex Limited announced that Mr. Ashish Mishra has tendered his resignation from the post of Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of the Company for better prospects, effective January 24, 2026. The Company has accepted his resignation and he will be relieved from his duties and responsibilities immediately. The Company will ensure the appointment of his successor within the time limits prescribed under the provisions of the Companies Act, 2013 and Listing Regulations and the same shall be intimated to the Stock Exchange(s). Mr. Mishra submitted his resignation letter on January 24, 2026, and confirmed there was no other material reason for his resignation.

news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 6.9% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Earnings have declined by 12% per year over the past 5 years. Revenue is less than US$1m (₹21m revenue, or US$234k).
